Table staging.int_postcode_geo — Postcode <-> suburb bridge: every (postcode, suburb) pair seen in the sale records, with a sale count. Does NOT collapse to one suburb per postcode — postcode <-> suburb is not 1:1, so every locality is present. Use it to resolve a suburb name to its postcode(s), especially for rent questions: marts.property_rent has no suburb (raw.property_rent has no locality), so "rent in <suburb>" means looking the suburb up here to get its postcode(s), then querying rent by postcode. Belongs to the `nsw_sales` dataset (RLS-scoped, since it's derived from sales).
Columns:
  postcode — Postcode.
  suburb — Suburb/locality sharing that postcode.
  n_sales — Number of sales carrying this postcode/suburb pairing (order by it desc for the dominant suburb).
